Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The input text describes two distinct MS datasets (PXD001454 and PXD001427). PXD001454 focuses on cross-linking MS of reconstituted recombinant 7TAF and 8TAF complexes. PXD001427 focuses on MudPIT analysis of endogenous TAF2-associated proteins immunoprecipitated from HeLa cell cytoplasmic and nuclear extracts. Both represent purified protein/complex scopes rather than whole cell lysates.
